description: The University of Cambridge Oracy Skills Framework organizes spoken-communication competencies into physical, linguistic, cognitive, and social-emotional strands for use in curriculum, classroom instruction, and assessment.
title: Oracy Skills Framework

description: A post-history-taking OSCE clinical-reasoning assessment task developed by Régent Alexis et al.
title: Oral Debrief (OD)

description: A validated seven-case clinical assessment instrument that presents oral-disease histories and images with five diagnosis options and confidence ratings to measure oral disease recognition and diagnostic-confidence calibration in dental learners and dentists.
title: Oral Disease Recognition Scale (ODRS) with seven clinical cases

description: A six-challenge framework developed from quality-improvement initiatives to guide and analyse implementation in healthcare organisations, including activities involving staff and managers.
title: Organising for Quality model

description: A standardized sentence-rearrangement assessment developed by Greene for children in grades three through eight to measure logical organization within sentences.
title: Organization Test

description: A computerized adaptive psychophysical assessment in which children judge relative segment orientation to estimate visual-processing discrimination thresholds.
title: Orientation discrimination task

description: Orthotrainer is a web-based application developed for structured, case-based orthodontic diagnostic training, providing interactive 3D and radiographic cases with embedded sample-solution feedback for dental learners.
title: Orthotrainer
